headline: Ash Blossom & Joyous Spring
title: Ash Blossom & Joyous Spring Explained | What It Does and How to Use It | Yu-Gi-Oh
video_script: This is Ash Blossom & Joyous Spring. What is it? It is a Level three FIRE Zombie Tuner, and one of the most used hand traps. What does it do? Discard it from your hand to negate an effect that adds a card from the Deck to the hand, Special Summons from the Deck, or sends a card from the Deck to the Graveyard. How do you use it? Hold it during your opponent's turn and use it on their first big search. Only once per turn. Which card should I explain next? Comment below!
